They take a fodder mixture mixed together, grain and straw, and red wool, blue wool, black wool and white wool.
They mix the grain and straw together
scatter it across the ḫaddari- of the road (crossroads?)
let them give this fodder mixture to the horses!
let the maidservants of the god take the red wool, blue wool, black wool, green wool and white wool!
he takes one kid, one piglet and one puppy
they cut them apart for the Sebettu (the 'Seven') in an untouched place
he libates [beer and wine(?)] to [the Sebettu], each three times.
